# Mozart data terms

Version 2026-11-09. Effective November 9, 2026.

These data terms are part of the Mozart Terms of Service and the Mozart Privacy Policy. They govern how Mozart Financial ("Mozart", "we", "us") uses the data that a customer ("Customer", "you") and its authorized users put into or connect to Mozart. Where these data terms and any other part of the Terms of Service or Privacy Policy conflict, these data terms control. A separately signed agreement that expressly overrides a section of these data terms controls for that section.

## 1. Definitions

- "Customer Data" means all information, documents, files, messages and other content that Customer or its authorized users submit to, upload to, connect to or receive through the services, including content obtained from Customer's connected systems (such as accounting systems, email and portals), together with all outputs the services generate from it.
- "Counterparty Materials" means Customer Data that originates from or concerns a third party with whom Customer does business, such as a customer, supplier, carrier, insurer, bank or government body.
- "Usage Data" means data about how the services are used and how work moves through them, including the steps taken, actions proposed, approvals, edits, rejections, timings, outcomes and system performance, in each case excluding the content of Customer Data.
- "De-identified Data" means data derived from Customer Data or Usage Data that does not identify, and cannot reasonably be used to identify, Customer, any authorized user or any natural person, and from which Mozart has removed or replaced the names of Customer and its counterparties.
- "Derived Datasets" means datasets, tasks, task environments, evaluations, benchmarks, demonstrations, labels, outcomes and similar materials that Mozart creates from De-identified Data, Usage Data or both, in any form.

## 2. License to Customer Data

Customer grants Mozart and its affiliates a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual and irrevocable license, which they may sublicense to their service providers, to host, copy, store, process, analyze, modify and create derivative works of Customer Data in order to:

- (a) provide, maintain and support the services;
- (b) develop, test, train and improve the services, Mozart's procedures, models and systems, and any machine learning or artificial intelligence models, whether Mozart's or a third party's acting for Mozart;
- (c) create De-identified Data and Derived Datasets.

This license survives the expiry or termination of the agreement.

## 3. Usage Data, De-identified Data and Derived Datasets

Mozart owns all right, title and interest in Usage Data, De-identified Data and Derived Datasets. Mozart may use, disclose, sell, license and otherwise commercialize them for any purpose, including licensing Derived Datasets to third parties for training, evaluating or improving artificial intelligence systems, during and after the term of the agreement. Mozart will not attempt to re-identify De-identified Data, and will contractually prohibit recipients of De-identified Data and Derived Datasets from attempting to re-identify them.

## 4. No opt-out

The uses in sections 2 and 3 are part of how the services operate and are priced. They are not optional, and no setting in the services disables them.

## 5. Customer's warranties about its data

Customer represents and warrants that:

- (a) it has all rights, licenses, consents and authority needed to submit Customer Data, including Counterparty Materials, to the services and to grant the license in section 2;
- (b) doing so does not breach any confidentiality obligation, contract or law binding Customer;
- (c) it has provided all notices to, and obtained all consents from, its personnel and other individuals that applicable law requires for the processing described in these data terms and the Privacy Policy.

Customer will indemnify Mozart against third-party claims arising from a breach of this section.

## 6. Confidentiality

Mozart's confidentiality obligations do not restrict its use of Customer Data as permitted by section 2, or its use or disclosure of Usage Data, De-identified Data or Derived Datasets.

## 7. Retention and deletion

On termination, and on Customer's written request, Mozart will delete or return Customer Data in its identifiable form within 90 days, except as required by law or for backups deleted in the ordinary course. Recordings of a person showing Mozart how a task is done are deleted 90 days after they are made. Usage Data, De-identified Data and Derived Datasets are not subject to deletion or return.

## 8. Governing law

These data terms are governed by Delaware law, and the courts in Delaware are the exclusive venue for any dispute about them.

## 9. Privacy: what we collect

We collect:

- the content you and your organization put into Mozart or connect to it, such as documents, messages, accounting records and portal data, including information about the organizations you work with and their staff;
- how you use Mozart, including requests to Ask Mozart, the actions Mozart proposes and takes, approvals, edits, corrections and outcomes;
- account details, such as name, work email and role;
- technical data, such as device, browser, IP address and logs.

## 10. Privacy: how we use it

We use it to:

- provide Mozart;
- improve Mozart, including training and evaluating AI models;
- create de-identified datasets, tasks and evaluations, which we may license to third parties, including AI developers;
- keep Mozart secure;
- comply with law.

## 11. Privacy: sale and sharing

We do not sell personal information. We license de-identified data, which cannot reasonably identify you, your organization or any individual, and we commit not to re-identify it.

## 12. Privacy: your choices

You may access, correct or delete your account information. Because your organization controls the content it puts into Mozart, contact your organization's administrator about that content. Questions: start@mozart.financial.
